title: Franklin and Gosling's 1953 diffraction paper
summary: Their Nature paper reports the molecular configuration of sodium thymonucleate from X-ray data.
body: Rosalind E. Franklin and R. G. Gosling, "Molecular Configuration in Sodium Thymonucleate" (Nature, 25 April 1953), published the diffraction evidence alongside the Watson-Crick structure paper. Franklin's work is a paper in the same issue, not a footnote. This card does not retell the personal history beyond what the publication record shows.
